Chapter 6 - Control Panel Guidelines

This chapter describes guidelines you must follow if you are designing control panels. Specifically, the following are discussed:
  • window design
  • fonts, menus, and icons
  • settings behavior
  • control panel access
  • assigning keyboard equivalents
  • on-screen help and assistance
